routes.label: registration and collection at an NCRA office

note: Sierra Leone's NCRA national identity card is mandatory for every national: the NCRA, the Police and the Office of National Security gave citizens until the end of 2024 to obtain it, after which other cards, the voter's card included, cease to serve as identification (DUBAWA, quoting an NCRA director). The card's price in new leones, its term, the age at which it is due and the time weren't found in what could be read. Tried 2026-10-30: a search found Awoko Newspaper's reports (2022) giving the national card as Le 75,000 in old leones, before the redenomination, but awokonewspapersl.com sits behind a Cloudflare check and archive.org holds no copy, so it wasn't read; no current NCRA fee was found, and the fee stays null.

sources.title: DUBAWA, Sierra Leone announces mandatory national ID cards: what you need to know
sources.said: He added that the national identity card that the Government of Sierra Leone (GoSL), through the people’s representatives, approved for every Sierra Leonean is a ‘mandatory ID card’ that all country nationals must have to guarantee free movement in the entire state. ... “In due time, every other form of identity card, including the ‘great voter’s card’ — which had been used over the years as a ‘strong force of identification’ will come to an end after January 1, 2025,” he said.
